releaseNotes: Color by WBS now works on the REAL pasted P6 schedule. The previous beta could report 'No WBS summary rows were found' on real pastes - that false negative is fixed and was validated on the exact workbook that failed.

The detector reads the whole outline the way P6 actually pastes it: band labels and activity IDs share the first column with per-level indentation, the name column is populated for activities only, single-word and multi-word bands are both recognized, and levels are measured from the real indentation (2 spaces per level), never guessed.

Detection now reports a confidence level. High-confidence sheets color directly after a compact summary; Medium/Low confidence opens the new WBS Mapping window - pick the columns and detection method, preview the first rows with the real P6 band colors, then Apply Mapping. Cancel always leaves the worksheet untouched, and the accepted mapping is remembered for the workbook.
Notices are now real Elmashad windows (same title bar, close button and footer buttons as every other tool window) - no detached system-style popups.
Logs carry a full [WBS-DETECT] diagnostics block: used range, header row, evidence availability, classification counts, level distribution and confidence.

Validated on the real failing workbook: 123 WBS bands and 328 activities detected (levels L0-L8), colored across the full schedule width in real Excel, activity rows untouched, second apply identical.
All release gates re-run: the exact built installer was executed on a fresh machine against an offline update endpoint, and the published bytes were re-downloaded and executed after publishing.
